faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to your questions about SikaPay and our crypto/Mobile Money conversion services.

items.q: What is SikaPay?
items.a: SikaPay is a conversion platform between cryptocurrencies and Mobile Money. It allows West African users to convert their crypto (USDT, USDC, etc.) to CFA francs (XOF) directly to their Mobile Money, and vice versa.

items.q: How does Off-Ramp (Crypto → Mobile Money) work?
items.a: To convert your crypto to XOF: 1) Select the token and blockchain network, 2) Enter the amount to convert, 3) Enter your Mobile Money number, 4) Send your crypto to the provided address, 5) Receive your XOF on your Mobile Money within minutes.

items.q: How does On-Ramp (Mobile Money → Crypto) work?
items.a: To buy crypto with your Mobile Money: 1) Select the desired token and network, 2) Enter the amount in XOF to convert, 3) Enter your blockchain wallet address, 4) Make the Mobile Money payment, 5) Receive your crypto in your wallet.

items.q: Do I need to create an account or do KYC verification?
items.a: No, SikaPay works without registration or identity verification (KYC). You can make transactions anonymously and quickly, preserving your privacy.

items.q: What tokens and networks are supported?
items.a: SikaPay supports USDT and USDC stablecoins on 9 blockchain networks: Base, BSC (BNB Smart Chain), Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Solana, Avalanche, and Lisk. More tokens and networks may be added in the future.

items.q: What Mobile Money operators are accepted?
items.a: We support the major Mobile Money operators in West Africa: Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money, Wave, Moov Money, and Free Money. Availability may vary by country.

items.q: In which countries is SikaPay available?
items.a: SikaPay is available in WAEMU zone countries using the CFA franc (XOF): Senegal, Mali, Burkina Faso, Ivory Coast, Togo, and Benin.

items.q: What are the transaction fees?
items.a: Fees are included in the displayed exchange rate. You see exactly how much you will receive before confirming your transaction. No hidden fees are applied.

items.q: How long does a transaction take?
items.a: Most transactions are processed within minutes. The exact time depends on the blockchain network used and Mobile Money payment confirmation. Typically, expect between 5 and 30 minutes.

items.q: What is the minimum/maximum amount per transaction?
items.a: The minimum amount is generally 5 USD (approximately 3,000 XOF). The maximum may vary based on your Mobile Money operator's limits and SikaPay policies. Contact our support for large amounts.

items.q: What if my transaction is pending?
items.a: If your transaction remains pending for more than 30 minutes, first verify that you sent funds to the correct address on the right network. Then contact our support with your transaction number for assistance.

items.q: How to contact support?
items.a: Our support team is available 24/7. You can reach us via WhatsApp, Telegram, or email. Contact details are available on our website.

items.q: How do I sell my USDT/USDC and receive XOF on my Mobile Money?
items.a: Open the "Crypto → Mobile Money" tab, pick the token (USDT or USDC) and the network your funds are on (Base, BSC, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Solana, Avalanche, Lisk), enter the amount, then fill in your country, operator (Orange Money, MTN, Moov, Wave, Free Money) and phone number. Send exactly the displayed amount to the deposit address shown, on the same network. As soon as the deposit is confirmed on-chain, the Mobile Money payout is triggered.

items.q: What are the fees and the rate — how much XOF will I actually receive?
items.a: No hidden fees: everything is included in the displayed rate. We start from the market USD/XOF rate and apply a 5% service margin. When selling (offramp) you receive amount × market rate × 0.95. When buying (onramp) you pay amount × market rate × 1.05. The final XOF amount is shown before you confirm and before you send any funds.

items.q: How long before the payout reaches my Mobile Money?
items.a: Typically 5 to 30 minutes end to end. The crypto deposit confirms in under a minute on Base, BSC, Solana or Polygon, and within a few minutes on Ethereum depending on congestion. The Mobile Money payout is then triggered immediately; final delivery depends on your operator's network availability.

items.q: Do I need KYC, and is it safe?
items.a: No KYC at all: no account, no ID document, no selfie. All you need is a stablecoin balance and a valid Mobile Money number in the XOF zone. Every transaction gets a unique reference (OFF-XXXXXX when selling, ONR-XXXXXX when buying), tracked in real time, with a downloadable PDF invoice.

items.q: What are the minimum and maximum limits, and which operators/networks are supported?
items.a: Amounts range from 100 to 600,000 XOF per transaction (your operator may apply its own limits). We support USDT and USDC on 9 networks (Base, BSC, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Solana, Avalanche, Lisk) and the Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money, Moov Money, Wave and Free Money operators in Senegal, Mali, Burkina Faso, Ivory Coast, Togo and Benin.

rate.title: Rate, margin and amount received
rate.intro: Our selling (offramp) rate is the market USD/XOF rate minus a 5% service margin. Here is the exact calculation, with no additional fees.
rate.formula: XOF received = stablecoin amount × market USD/XOF rate × 0.95
notes: The market rate is fetched live: the amount shown on the form is the one that applies.
When buying (onramp) the margin applies the other way: you pay amount × rate × 1.05.
Blockchain network fees (gas) are paid by your own wallet when sending and are not charged by SikaPay.

safety.title: No KYC and safe
safety.intro: SikaPay asks for no account and no ID. In exchange, you send your USDT/USDC to a deposit address operated by SikaPay — here is what to know before sending.
checklist: The network you send on must exactly match the selected network: a cross-network send is unrecoverable.
Copy the deposit address from the page or scan the QR code — never type it by hand.
The deposit address is specific to your transaction: do not reuse it for a later send.
Send exactly the displayed amount; a different amount can delay processing.
Double-check your Mobile Money number and operator before confirming: the payout goes to that number.
Keep your reference (OFF-XXXXXX or ONR-XXXXXX) and the PDF invoice for follow-up.
know: No identity data is collected: we only keep what the transaction needs (amount, number, address, reference).
The deposit address is custodial: funds pass through SikaPay for the duration of settlement, then are paid out in XOF.
Only send USDT or USDC on a supported network: other tokens are not processed and cannot be returned automatically.
The service covers amounts between 100 and 600,000 XOF; above that, contact support before sending.
If in doubt, make a small first transfer to validate the flow.
